original_ai_output.title_zh: 肯尼亚确认首例埃博拉死亡病例，疫情持续蔓延
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 肯尼亚确认该国首例埃博拉病例，患者为一名在刚果（金）居住七年的肯尼亚公民，抵达内罗毕后死亡。刚果（金）今年已有超过4000人死于埃博拉，世界卫生组织记录当前疫情累计4114例死亡、8544例病例。卫生部门已加强机场和边境检查，并追踪至少28名接触者及同机乘客。

key_facts.fact: 肯尼亚确认首例埃博拉病例，患者死亡
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Kenya has confirmed its first ever case of Ebola - a Kenyan citizen who has been living in the Democratic Republic of Congo for the past seven years.

key_facts.fact: 患者为在刚果（金）居住七年的肯尼亚公民，抵达内罗毕后死亡
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the patient, who fell ill a month ago, and was treated in several hospitals in DR Congo, died days after arriving in the capital, Nairobi.

key_facts.fact: 刚果（金）今年已有超过4000人死于埃博拉
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: More than 4,000 people have died from Ebola in DR Congo this year, in what is the second most deadly known outbreak of the disease.

key_facts.fact: 世界卫生组织记录当前疫情4114例死亡、8544例病例
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The WHO has recorded 4,114 deaths out of 8,544 cases in the current outbreak

key_facts.fact: 至少28名接触者被识别，另有23名乘客和4名机组人员正在追踪
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: At least 28 contacts, including family members and healthcare workers, have been identified, while health authorities are tracing a further 23 passengers and four crew members who travelled on the same flight.

key_facts.fact: 肯尼亚已加强机场和边境检查
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Kenya introduced tighter checks at airports and border posts after the outbreak was declared in DR Congo but these have now been further intensified.

uncertainties: 患者可能因服药掩盖症状而通过机场筛查（据一名高级卫生部官员称）
无国界医生认为实际死亡人数可能更高，因监测和检测存在缺口
当前疫情由相对罕见的本迪布焦型埃博拉病毒引起，尚无获批疫苗或治疗方法
